description: Agreement for the Transfer of Sentenced Persons between Sri Lanka and the Kingdom of Thailand
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2018-09-11
decision_details_body: - The proposal made by Hon. (Mrs.) Thalatha Atukorala, the Minister of Justice & Prison Reforms, to present the Agreement entered into between Sri Lanka and Thailand on the Transfer of Sentenced Persons, in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.
